global_compress.description: Whether to compress rotated logs globally (gzip)

global_dateext.description: Append date extension to rotated filenames (e.g., -20240501)

global_dateformat.description: Date format for extension (Python strftime-like; used only if dateext=true)

global_rotate.description: Number of rotated logs to keep (0 = remove immediately)

global_create.description: New log file permissions, owner, group (octal mode, user, group)

global_missingok.description: Suppress error if log file is missing

global_notifempty.description: Skip rotation if log file is empty
